device.cpu_reference: libjpeg-turbo is not available on iOS: the CPU comparison is ImageIO (Apple's codec); exactness is checked against SHA-256 hashes of libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0 output

cells.method: sizes 640x480, 1600x1200, 4032x3024, decode and encode (q90 4:2:0 Synth images; encode from a shared MTLBuffer); 5 reps per cell, cells interleaved within a rep; each rep waits 0.35 s, asks DeviceProfile.current.routingDecision (default rates, detected warmth), then times the GPU (Decoder/Encoder) and the CPU (ImageIO, quality 0.9, inside beginCPUWork()/end with the default rate), each after a 0.35 s gap, order alternating; a rep is wrong when the picked side took more than 1.25x the other, lost ms = picked minus other; conditions idle or 4 in-process busy-loop threads at default QoS (started 1 s before, stopped after), load correction off/on alternated via DeviceProfile.loadCorrectionEnabled, DeviceProfileTesting.resetLoadCorrection() before each, 2 rounds
